title: NEPS | Youth wellbeing. Shared futures.
description: An African-led, multi-country research programme exploring educational pressure, poverty, stigma and youth mental wellbeing in Ghana, Sierra Leone and Tanzania.

title: About NEPS | NEPS
description: Navigating Educational Pressures and Stressors is a multi-country youth mental-health research programme across Ghana, Sierra Leone and Tanzania.

title: Contact | NEPS
description: For programme enquiries, collaboration and engagement. Contact details are awaiting confirmation. Please do not include participant information, medical histories or other sensitive personal details.

title: Country implementation | NEPS
description: Ghana, Sierra Leone and Tanzania contribute distinct settings to a connected research programme. Harmonised questions support comparison; local knowledge guides interpretation and adaptation. [1]

title: Creative Art Therapy · WP6 | NEPS
description: A six-session intervention pathway uses creative expression, storytelling, drama, reflection and safe group processes. It aims to support emotional awareness, self-expression, coping, confidence and stigma reduction. These are aims to be evaluated, not established NEPS outcomes. [4]

title: Data, ethics & safeguarding | NEPS
description: Respect, voluntary participation, privacy and participant protection guide the programme’s approach. Country-specific arrangements and the scope of each approved protocol govern research activities. [1,3]

title: Governance & consortium | NEPS
description: The consortium brings programme leadership, work package coordination, country delivery and advisory perspectives together. The layout below identifies programme leadership, country Co-PIs and coordinators, work package leads and management personnel alongside the wider advisory structures. It does not assert formal reporting lines.

title: News & updates | NEPS
description: Follow the NEPS programme's latest research updates, engagement activities and implementation learning across Ghana, Sierra Leone and Tanzania.

title: NEPS Project Team Equips Enumerators for Field Data Collection | NEPS
description: The NEPS Project strengthened the capacity of eight research assistants to undertake field data collection through a one-day training held at USTED.

title: SFA Delegation, NEPS Research Team Engage College Of Health Sciences On Ghana Site Visit | NEPS
description: A delegation from the Science for Africa Foundation and NEPS researchers paid a courtesy call on the KNUST College of Health Sciences during a three-day Ghana site visit.

title: USTED, KNUST Host SFA Foundation Team For NEPS Youth Mental Health Project Review | NEPS
description: Researchers from USTED and KNUST hosted a Science for Africa Foundation delegation as part of the Ghana site visit and implementation review for the NEPS Project.

title: Policy & advocacy | NEPS
description: NEPS connects evidence with youth perspectives, stakeholder dialogue and practical implementation questions. Policy translation is a process of learning and co-creation. [1]

title: Publications & outputs | NEPS
description: This catalogue will bring together verified NEPS publications and public outputs. An empty category does not mean that no work exists; it means no item has yet been verified for this website.

title: Research framework | NEPS
description: Young people’s lives are interconnected. NEPS studies how pressures, relationships and environments interact over time, using a relational wellbeing framework. [1]

title: Resources | NEPS
description: A home for approved manuals, briefs, training materials, reports, tools, templates and publications. Resource cards below are placeholders; no unpublished source documents are offered for download.

description: Meet the programme leadership, country Co-PIs and coordinators, work package leads and project management personnel. Biographies and photographs will be added as they become available; unspecified affiliations remain clearly marked.

title: Work packages | NEPS
description: Explore the purpose, activities and planned outputs of each work package. Together, they connect scientific enquiry, youth participation, delivery and accountability.

title: Youth Mental Health Manual | NEPS
description: The NEPS manual brings mental-health awareness, everyday support and safe referral into school and community settings. This page describes its scope; the public download awaits release approval. [2]
